mapper.select: SELECT I.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, I.TITLE AS title, I.CONTENT AS content, I.INQUIRY_STATUS AS inquiryStatus, DATE_FORMAT(I.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(I.UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt, I.USER_ID AS userId, R.REPLY_ID AS replyId, R.CONTENT AS answer, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS replyCreatedAt FROM INQUIRY I LEFT JOIN INQUIRY_REPLY R ON I.INQUIRY_ID = R.INQUIRY_ID WHERE I.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT ${pageSize} OFFSET ${offset}

SELECT INQUIRY_IMG_ID AS inquiryImgId, IMG_URL AS imgUrl, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId FROM INQUIRY_IMG WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry ( TITLE, CONTENT, INQUIRY_TYPE, INQUIRY_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{inquiryType}, #{inquiryStatus}, NOW(), NOW(), #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT I.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, I.TITLE AS title, I.CONTENT AS content, I.INQUIRY_STATUS AS inquiryStatus, I.INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, I.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, I.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, I.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.EMAIL AS userEmail, IFNULL(R.REPLY_ID, 0) AS replyId FROM INQUIRY I LEFT JOIN USER U ON I.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN INQUIRY_REPLY R ON I.INQUIRY_ID = R.INQUIRY_ID WHERE I.INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} AND I.USER_ID = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRY SET TITLE = #{title}, INQUIRY_TYPE = #{inquiryType}, CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INQUIRY_REPLY R WHERE R.INQUIRY_ID = INQUIRY.INQUIRY_ID )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry_img ( IMG_URL, CREATED_AT, INQUIRY_ID ) VALUES ( #{imgUrl}, NOW(), #{inquiryId} )
mapper.select: SELECT INQUIRY_IMG_ID AS inquiryImgId, IMG_URL AS imgUrl, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId FROM INQUIRY_IMG WHERE INQUIRY_IMG_ID = #{inquiryImgId}
